# casbin-regen

We use this library to decide whether a subject may take an action on an object, to keep the rules behind those decisions, and to ask questions about them afterwards. Since the last round of unlabelled changes it misbehaves in many places that have nothing to do with each other, and the failures range from wrong answers to outright errors. The repository has received 29 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything we managed to reproduce, described by what we did and what came back.

Start with asking whether one request is allowed. A request whose subject is a structure of attributes, a map of attribute names to values, or a JSON document carrying the same attributes, judged by an expression that reads those attributes, comes back denied in all three forms, although the very same expression answers fine when the arguments are plain strings. Requests that carry a tenant as one of their fields and work out a user's memberships within that tenant are refused when they should be allowed, because a membership granted with a wildcard tenant no longer applies, both in the usual arrangement where the tenant is the second field and when that field has been given a different name.
